details.description: GPT-5.2 Pro is OpenAI's reasoning-focused, most compute-intensive tier of GPT-5.2, released December 11, 2025 (default snapshot gpt-5.2-pro-2025-12-11) for complex professional work needing step-by-step reasoning, careful instruction-following and accuracy in high-stakes use cases. It takes text and image input and produces text output, with three reasoning-effort levels (medium, high, xhigh) -- it omits the lower/no-reasoning modes available on base GPT-5.2 -- and a knowledge cutoff of August 31, 2025. It supports image input alongside an image-generation tool, file search, web search and MCP tool use through OpenAI's Responses API. As of this research, OpenAI's own model-card page for GPT-5.2 Pro already labels it 'our previous pro model for complex professional work' and recommends GPT-5.5 Pro for current deployments, although OpenAI has not listed a specific shutdown date for it on its API deprecations page.
advantages: Supports xhigh reasoning effort, OpenAI's most compute-intensive setting, intended for high-stakes professional and complex reasoning tasks (OpenAI API docs).
Supports image input alongside an image-generation tool, file search, web search and MCP tool use via the Responses API (OpenAI API docs).
disadvantages: OpenAI's own model-card page already describes GPT-5.2 Pro as its 'previous pro model,' recommending GPT-5.5 Pro for current deployments, as of this research date (OpenAI API docs).
Does not offer the 'none' or 'low' reasoning-effort settings available on base GPT-5.2; only medium, high and xhigh are supported (OpenAI API docs).
Output is text-only; no native audio or video output (OpenAI API docs).
Knowledge cutoff of August 31, 2025 (OpenAI API docs).
use_cases: Complex professional and knowledge-work tasks needing high accuracy
Tasks combining image understanding with deep reasoning

notes: Catalog's max_input_tokens (272,000) conflicts with OpenAI's own model-card page, which states a 400,000-token context window; kept the catalog's value per instructions. Catalog lists /v1/batch and /v1/chat/completions as supported endpoints, but OpenAI's model-card page states only the Responses API is supported and that Chat Completions, Batch, Assistants and Realtime are unsupported for this model; kept the catalog's endpoint facts as instructed but flagging the conflict. No evaluations entry included: Artificial Analysis does not appear to index a separate 'GPT-5.2 Pro' benchmark page (search and a direct fetch of the likely URL both failed), and third-party blog claims of specific scores (e.g. a claimed 100% AIME) were never opened and are excluded per the no-blog-test-runs rule. Catalog's deprecation_date is empty, consistent with OpenAI not having published a formal shutdown date for gpt-5.2-pro specifically, even though its own model card already recommends GPT-5.5 Pro instead.
